/// A pointer interaction: the pointer's id and its position in local
/// coordinates.
///
/// `Node` pointer handlers receive one, and an `Artboard` instance takes one
/// to forward the interaction to its state machine.
/// ```as
/// export class RenderInstance extends Node {
///     @input character: Artboard? = null;
///     instance: Artboard? = null;
///     x: f32 = 100;
///     y: f32 = 50;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let character = this.character;
///         if (character != null) {
///             this.instance = character.instance();
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
///
///     override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
///         let instance = this.instance;
///         if (instance != null) {
///             let localPos = event.position - Vector.xy(this.x, this.y);
///             let localEvent = new PointerEvent(event.id, localPos);
///             if (instance.pointerDown(localEvent) != 0) {
///                 event.hit();
///             }
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class PointerEvent {
    /// The unique identifier for the pointer.
    id: f64;

    /// The position of the pointer in local coordinates.
    position: Vector;

    /// The pointer's previous position in local coordinates. Set on events a
    /// `ListenerContext` delivers; `Node` pointer handlers read the origin.
    previousPosition: Vector;

    /// The kind of interaction: `pointerEnter`, `pointerExit`, `pointerDown`,
    /// `pointerUp`, `pointerMove`, `click`, `pointerDrag` or `unknown`.
    /// `pointerMove` handlers see every move, enter, click and drag this way.
    type: string;

    /// When the interaction happened, in seconds.
    timeStamp: f64;

    /// Creates a pointer event with the given id and position, for example to
    /// forward an interaction to an `Artboard` instance in its own space.
    /// ```as
    /// let event = new PointerEvent(0, Vector.xy(10, 20));
    /// ```
    constructor(
        id: f64,
        position: Vector,
        previousPosition: Vector = Vector(),
        type: string = "unknown",
        timeStamp: f64 = 0
    );

    /// Consumes the event. Call it on every event a script owns (the press,
    /// each move of a drag, and the release) or the event keeps travelling
    /// outward and an enclosing hit target claims the gesture. A
    /// `ScrollConstraint` viewport is the usual one: without this, dragging a
    /// control inside a scroll view scrolls the view instead.
    ///
    /// The argument inverts. Bare `hit()` is opaque and stops there;
    /// `hit(true)` marks this target translucent, so the event continues to
    /// whatever is behind it.
    /// ```as
    /// override pointerDown(event: PointerEvent): void {
    ///     let instance = this.instance;
    ///     if (instance != null && instance.pointerDown(event) != 0) {
    ///         // Handled, but translucent targets behind still receive it.
    ///         event.hit(true);
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    hit(isTranslucent: bool = false): void;
}

/// Where a `ScrollEvent` sits within its gesture. A mouse wheel only ever
/// reports `update`.
export const enum ScrollPhase {
    /// Fingers started a trackpad gesture.
    begin = 0,

    /// The gesture moved, or a wheel turned.
    update = 1,

    /// The fingers lifted. Hosts whose platform sends its own momentum never
    /// report it.
    end = 2,

    /// Platform generated travel after the fingers lifted.
    momentum = 3,

    /// Fingers landed during momentum to stop it. Carries no delta.
    inertiaCancel = 4,
}

/// A scroll from a mouse wheel or a trackpad, delivered to
/// `Node.pointerScroll`. Direct touch arrives as pointer events instead.
/// ```as
/// override pointerScroll(event: ScrollEvent): void {
///     this.zoom *= Math.exp(-event.delta.y * 0.01);
///     event.hit();
/// }
/// ```
export class ScrollEvent {
    /// The unique identifier for the pointer.
    id: f64;

    /// The pointer's position in local coordinates.
    position: Vector;

    /// How far the content should travel, in local coordinates. It follows
    /// the content, as a `ScrollConstraint` does, so revealing content
    /// further down reads as a negative `y`.
    delta: Vector;

    /// Where the event sits within its gesture.
    phase: ScrollPhase;

    /// True for a pixel precise source like a trackpad, false for a mouse
    /// wheel that moves in detents.
    precise: bool;

    /// When the scroll happened, in seconds.
    timeStamp: f64;

    /// Claims the scroll. Without it the scroll passes to whatever lies
    /// behind, such as a `ScrollConstraint` view. A claimed trackpad gesture
    /// stays with this node until it ends.
    hit(): void;
}

/// A keyboard interaction, delivered to `Node.keyboardEvent`.
/// ```as
/// override keyboardEvent(event: KeyboardEvent): bool {
///     if (event.phase == "down" && event.shift) {
///         this.boost = true;
///         return true;
///     }
///     return false;
/// }
/// ```
export class KeyboardEvent {
    /// The key code of the key.
    key: f64;

    /// True if the Shift modifier is active.
    shift: bool;

    /// True if the Control modifier is active.
    control: bool;

    /// True if the Alt modifier is active.
    alt: bool;

    /// True if the Meta (Command or Windows) modifier is active.
    meta: bool;

    /// The phase of the interaction: `down`, `repeat` or `up`.
    phase: string;
}

/// A gamepad's full state, delivered when a device connects, when one of its
/// buttons or axes changes, and when it disconnects. `kind` says which.
///
/// Button and axis indices are 0 based W3C Standard Gamepad slots. The named
/// reads such as `south` or `leftStick` answer only when `isStandardMapping`
/// is true, and read false or 0 otherwise; read any other device by index.
/// ```as
/// override gamepadEvent(event: GamepadEvent): bool {
///     if (event.south) {
///         this.jump = true;
///         return true;
///     }
///     this.move = event.leftStick;
///     return false;
/// }
/// ```
export class GamepadEvent {
    /// Why the event fired: `connected`, `event` or `disconnected`.
    kind: string;

    /// A stable id for this device for as long as it stays connected.
    deviceId: i32;

    /// The raw mapping value: 0 for the standard layout, 1 for unknown.
    gamepadMapping: u32;

    /// What changed on an `event`: `button` or `axis`. Empty for the
    /// other kinds.
    changeKind: string;

    /// The 0 based index of the button or axis that changed.
    changeIndex: u32;

    /// The new value of the button or axis that changed.
    changeValue: f32;

    /// True when the change maps to a standard layout button, named by
    /// `intentButton`.
    hasStandardButtonIntent: bool;

    /// The 0 based standard button index behind `intentButton`, valid when
    /// `hasStandardButtonIntent` is true.
    standardButton: u32;

    /// True when the change maps to a standard layout axis, named by
    /// `intentAxis`.
    hasStandardAxisIntent: bool;

    /// The 0 based standard axis index behind `intentAxis`, valid when
    /// `hasStandardAxisIntent` is true.
    standardAxis: u32;

    /// The analog value of every button, from 0 to 1, by 0 based W3C index.
    buttons: StaticArray<f32>;

    /// The value of every axis by 0 based W3C index. The standard layout
    /// has at least six: the two sticks, then the two triggers.
    axes: StaticArray<f32>;

    /// The value of the axis at the given 0 based index, or 0 when the
    /// device does not report it.
    axis(index: i32): f32;

    /// The analog value, from 0 to 1, of the button at the given 0 based
    /// index, or 0 when the device does not report it.
    buttonValue(index: i32): f32;

    /// True if the button at the given 0 based W3C index is pressed.
    buttonPressed(index: i32): bool;

    /// Every button's pressed state as bits: bit `i` is set when the button at
    /// index `i` is pressed.
    get buttonMask(): u64;

    /// True when the host normalized the device to the W3C standard layout.
    get isStandardMapping(): bool;

    /// The layout: `standard` or `unknown`. Named reads answer only on
    /// `standard`.
    get mapping(): string;

    /// The standard name of the button that changed, such as `south` or
    /// `dpadUp`, or null when the change has no standard button intent.
    get intentButton(): string?;

    /// The standard name of the axis that changed, such as `leftX` or
    /// `rightTriggerAxis`, or null when the change has no standard axis
    /// intent.
    get intentAxis(): string?;

    /// True when the bottom face button (A on Xbox, Cross on PlayStation) is
    /// pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get south(): bool;

    /// True when the right face button (B on Xbox, Circle on PlayStation) is
    /// pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get east(): bool;

    /// True when the left face button (X on Xbox, Square on PlayStation) is
    /// pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get west(): bool;

    /// True when the top face button (Y on Xbox, Triangle on PlayStation) is
    /// pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get north(): bool;

    /// True when the left shoulder button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get leftShoulder(): bool;

    /// True when the right shoulder button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get rightShoulder(): bool;

    /// True when the left trigger is pressed as a digital button. Standard
    /// mapping only.
    get leftTriggerPressed(): bool;

    /// True when the right trigger is pressed as a digital button. Standard
    /// mapping only.
    get rightTriggerPressed(): bool;

    /// True when the back (select) button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get back(): bool;

    /// True when the forward (start) button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get forward(): bool;

    /// True when the left stick is clicked. Standard mapping only.
    get leftStickButton(): bool;

    /// True when the right stick is clicked. Standard mapping only.
    get rightStickButton(): bool;

    /// True when the d-pad up button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get dpadUp(): bool;

    /// True when the d-pad down button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get dpadDown(): bool;

    /// True when the d-pad left button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get dpadLeft(): bool;

    /// True when the d-pad right button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get dpadRight(): bool;

    /// True when the center (home) button is pressed. Standard mapping only.
    get start(): bool;

    /// The left stick's horizontal deflection, from -1 to 1. Standard mapping

    get leftX(): f32;

    /// The left stick's vertical deflection, from -1 to 1. Standard mapping

    get leftY(): f32;

    /// The right stick's horizontal deflection, from -1 to 1. Standard mapping

    get rightX(): f32;

    /// The right stick's vertical deflection, from -1 to 1. Standard mapping

    /// The right trigger's analog value, axis 5. Standard mapping only.

/// What triggered a listener action, read from `ListenerContext.kind`.
export const enum ListenerKind {
    /// A pointer event.
    pointer = 0,

    /// A keyboard event.
    keyboard = 1,

    /// A text input event.
    textInput = 2,

    /// A focus change.
    focus = 3,

    /// A reported Rive event.
    reportedEvent = 4,

    /// A view model change.
    viewModelChange = 5,

    /// An unknown or unsupported event.
    none = 6,

    /// A gamepad connected.
    gamepadConnected = 7,

    /// A gamepad button or axis changed.
    gamepadEvent = 8,

    /// A gamepad disconnected.
    gamepadDisconnected = 9,

    /// A semantic action: a tap, increase or decrease.
    semantic = 10,
}

/// The event that triggered a listener action, passed to
/// `ListenerAction.performAction`.
///
/// It can hold a pointer, keyboard, text input, focus, gamepad, view model
/// change or reported event. Check the type with the `is` methods, or switch
/// on `kind`, and read the event with the matching `as` method.
/// ```as
/// override performAction(context: ListenerContext): void {
///     let pointer = context.asPointerEvent();
///     if (pointer != null) {
///         this.lastClick = pointer.position;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class ListenerContext {
    /// What triggered the action.
    kind: ListenerKind;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a pointer event.
    isPointerEvent(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a keyboard event.
    isKeyboardEvent(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a text input event.
    isTextInput(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a focus change.
    isFocus(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a reported Rive event.
    isReportedEvent(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a view model change.
    isViewModelChange(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by an unknown or unsupported
    /// event.
    isNone(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a gamepad connecting.
    isGamepadConnected(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a gamepad button or axis
    /// change.
    isGamepadEvent(): bool;

    /// Returns true if the action was triggered by a gamepad disconnecting.
    isGamepadDisconnected(): bool;

    /// Returns the pointer event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asPointerEvent(): PointerEvent?;

    /// Returns the keyboard event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asKeyboardEvent(): KeyboardEvent?;

    /// Returns the text input event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asTextInput(): TextInput?;

    /// Returns the focus event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asFocus(): FocusEvent?;

    /// Returns the gamepad state for a connect if applicable, otherwise null.
    asGamepadConnected(): GamepadEvent?;

    /// Returns the gamepad state after a button or axis change if applicable,
    /// otherwise null.
    asGamepadEvent(): GamepadEvent?;

    /// Returns the gamepad state for a disconnect if applicable, otherwise
    /// null.
    asGamepadDisconnected(): GamepadEvent?;

    /// Returns the reported event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asReportedEvent(): ReportedEvent?;

    /// Returns the view model change if applicable, otherwise null.
    asViewModelChange(): ViewModelChange?;

    /// Returns a none event if applicable, otherwise null.
    asNone(): NoneEvent?;
}
